name: omnibase/estate
description: Property management for omnibase: organisations, buildings and units, associates, leases and tenants, rent calls, receipts and online payment, contractors and work orders, invitations and a private space for each - posting to omnibase/ledger

suggest.omnibase/ledger: Rent calls, payments and work invoices posted to the company's books; an agency's management and sale fees
suggest.omnisense/omnitrade: Rent paid online (omnitrade/stripe: card and SEPA debit)
suggest.dompdf/dompdf: Rent notices, receipts, co-owners' and owners' statements as PDF
suggest.omnibase/drive: A shared ownership's cloud folder, shared with its co-owners; an owner's folder under management; a sale's folder, shared with its seller and buyer; a tenant's folder; each person's space for files shared on upload
suggest.omnibank/files: The owners' payouts as a SEPA credit transfer file (pain.001) for the bank
suggest.omnisense/omnisign: The lease, its inventory and the guarantors' deeds signed electronically (1.2 or later: the mention typed as a statement; with omnisign/docuseal or omnisign/yousign, and omnisense/omnibase's Signatures)
suggest.omnistate/insee: The IRL of a rent revision read from INSEE (with omnisense/omnistate's statistics), its source credited; without it the value is typed by hand
